work.title: Piano Concerto No. 2 in C minor

version.note: The performing edition, revision and any editorial interventions are not identified in the consulted recording documentation.

date.note: Commons gives 1 January 1959, but the embedded tag gives only the year. The dated 9/59 sleeve is a release-carrier date, not a session date. No day or month is adopted without session documentation.

place.note: The original issue identifies the recording collaboration with Polskie Nagrania in Warsaw; a particular hall is not documented in this source.

catalogue.note: Documented original stereo issue. The precise LP, CD or digital edition copied into the Commons FLAC is unknown.

matrixTakeSides.note: No matrix, take or side information is established. A digital file alone does not establish that no earlier physical carrier existed.

credits.note: The original recording credits name Heinz Wildhagen (recording engineer) and Hans Weber (recording supervisor). They are not documented as the transfer or restoration staff for this FLAC.

date.note: No transfer date is documented; upload and encoding-software dates are not session or transfer dates.

processing.value: Embedded encoder: libFLAC 1.3.2 20170101. Commons master: FLAC, 16-bit, 44.1 kHz, 2 channels.
processing.note: These are file properties, not evidence of noise reduction, equalisation, pitch correction or other restoration. Earlier processing is not documented.

digital.format: MP3 access derivative; Commons master: FLAC, 16-bit, 44.1 kHz, 2 channels

composition.value: Original composition is public domain in ordinary life-plus-70 jurisdictions.
composition.note: The composer died in 1943. Rights in the 1959 recording are separate; this is not a worldwide clearance for every edition.

recording.value: Commons asserts public-domain status in the European Union under PD-EU-audio.
recording.note: This is not a worldwide licence. US pre-1972 sound-recording terms differ under 17 U.S.C. § 1401; US reuse of this recording and any separately protected restoration is not established by the Commons tag.

rights.creditLine: Sviatoslav Richter, piano; Warsaw National Philharmonic Orchestra; Stanisław Wisłocki, conductor. Deutsche Grammophon source, via Wikimedia Commons. Commons asserts EU public-domain recording status (PD-EU-audio); rights elsewhere are not established.
